text.en:
The San Juan Municipal High School in the Municipality of San Juan, Province of Abra, is
hereby converted into a national school to be known as the Northern Abra National High School. Said school
shall offer general secondary curriculum, vocational curriculum and other technological courses.

The Minister of Education and Culture is hereby empowered to reorganize said school
accordingly.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 for the Ministry of
Education and Culture intended for new national schools. Starting Calendar Year 1983 such sum as may be
necessary for the operation and maintenance of the school shall be provided in the annual General
Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
